description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs and pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs each define an identical private fn de_static_str that leaks a String to produce &'static str. The two functions have the same body and the same doc comment. Idiomatic Rust would place this in a private serde_helpers submodule (cfg(feature="serde")) and import it from both call sites, eliminating the copy-paste maintenance hazard.
title: de_static_str duplicated in lib.rs and deviation.rs
